meta_description:
6,556 likes, 36 comments - tejasjosh.i on August 24, 2026: "India’s payment habits have transformed and UPI is at the heart of it.

What began as a digital alternative to cash has become a seamless part of everyday life, from paying for a cup of tea to transferring money in seconds.

Bank of India has grown alongside this transformation, with UPI transactions rising from 2.26 crore to 965.39 crore in just a decade.

Technology creates change, but simplicity drives adoption.

#BankOfIndia #UPI #Digitallndia #DigitalPayments #Banking".
